status: post-opening functional-community analysis frozen before endpoint readback
sample: same 4,236 matched wet-dry route x seasonal-window pairs; exact-consecutive-year sensitivity prespecified

frozen_core_trait_space.coverage_from_outcome_blind_audit: 42 species; 93.2% of eligible run x species incidences
frozen_core_trait_space.scaling: z-score each derived trait across all complete matched species before community calculations
frozen_core_trait_space.distance: Euclidean distance in four-dimensional standardized trait space divided by sqrt(4)

primary_endpoints.name: delta_functional_mpd
primary_endpoints.definition: wet minus dry mean pairwise functional distance among trait-covered active species in the route-run; requires >=2 covered species in each run
primary_endpoints.interpretation: positive = broader functional dispersion; zero with taxonomic richness gain = functional redundancy

primary_endpoints.name: functional_novelty_balance
primary_endpoints.definition: mean nearest-neighbour trait distance of wet-only covered species to the dry covered assemblage minus the symmetric distance of dry-only covered species to the wet covered assemblage
primary_endpoints.interpretation: positive = wetter assemblages recruit more functionally novel species; zero/negative = taxonomic additions mostly occupy existing trait space

secondary_multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the four CWM centroid-shift tests only

model.formula: response ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)
model.mpd_richness_sensitivity: repeat delta_functional_mpd model adding delta_trait_covered_richness as a covariate

interpretation_boundary.functional: broad life-history/reproductive trait space represented by the four frozen AmphiBIO axes, not complete ecological function
interpretation_boundary.trait_coverage: unmatched species complexes are excluded rather than imputed
